correctness.rationale: For tied maximum parts, the odd-order construction is a restriction of the standard proper N-edge-coloring of K_N; the missing palette at each vertex is a translate of one part, made independent in the residue cycle by a Dirac Hamiltonian cycle. For even order, the standard one-factorization over Z_{N-1} is proper; the label placement makes every same-part finite label set independent in the step-two cycle, and the infinity-part labels also avoid step one. Therefore every missing-color set has no consecutive integers. Edge cases s=1 and bipartite/unique-largest cases are explicitly separated. The standalone verifier exhaustively stress-tests all new tied-maximum types through order 16. The finite test is not used as the infinite proof.
